review_candidates.title: Remote Technical Support Engineer II
review_candidates.description_excerpt: It focuses on IT infrastructure management for small- to mid-sized businesses, addressing the challenge of maintaining diverse and complex IT environments across multiple clients. The role involves troubleshooting, systems administration, and mentorship, directly contributing to maintaining reliable IT infrastructure for clients and ensuring high-quality service delivery. Responsibilities: • Resolve escalated support requests and complex technical issues. • Troubleshoot Windows, macOS, Microsoft
eligibility_evidence: • Provide remote and onsite support for client environments.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements: • CompTIA A+ and/or Network+ certification required or to be obtained within 6 months. • Preferred certification: MD-102.
